historia.texto: No último show da turnê no Brasil, o Eddie achou na plateia um fã com um cartaz: era aniversário dele e ele queria cantar uma música com a banda. O Eddie lembrou que tinha visto o mesmo cartaz três dias antes, e alguns dias antes disso também. Mais tarde chamou o fã pro palco, passou a garrafa de vinho, que ele virou com vontade, e deixou ele cantar o começo de Porch. Antes de Imagine, falou dos atentados de Paris e de um fã que estava sempre na grade nos shows da Europa e estava entre os mortos. No segundo bis, foi pro piano no fim de Comfortably Numb e quebrou uma Gibson SG branca em Better Man. Em Alive, se enrolou numa bandeira do Brasil cheia de recados. Em Yellow Ledbetter, vestiu por cima da calça uma sunga vermelha jogada da plateia.
historia.rotuloFonte: Fanviews do fórum oficial do Pearl Jam

fontes.trecho: Noting it is the last show in Brazil but not the last show forever just this tour.

He points out a man in the audience with a sign that reads “It’s My Birthday Can I please sing a song with you?”  Ed says “It is your birthday?  Now let’s see I saw you 3 days ago holding the same sign and a few days before that with the same sign.

Ed brings up the birthday man (Adu?(sp).  The man is very pleased.  Ed takes a swig of wine and passes the bottle to they guy who proceeds to take a very long pull on the bottle.  Ed lets him sing the opening lines of Porch before taking over.)

it broke our hearts even more when we and more deeply when we heard that someone, a really good man, a father of two, a great husband, great brother, a great son and he was always in the front row of the shows when we played in Europe.  And we found out recently that he lost his life
Comfortably Numb-(Gilmour, Waters) {Ed plays piano during the outro solo}
At the end of the song Ed smashes white Gibson SG.)
Alive- (draped in an a Brazilian flag with messages and autographs all over it Ed goes to the wings of the stage.
someone throws up a red pair of swim trunks.  Ed asks “for me?” and shrugs.  He ends up putting the trunks on over his pants and continues singing.)
